noLimitWithoutSignIn.title: No limit while customer sign-in is paused
noLimitWithoutSignIn.description: On: guests have no message limit while the Customer role's sign-in is paused in Accounts (Roles and permissions), as on a website that does not use sign-in. Needs the Accounts token in Connections; a change in Accounts applies within a minute.

contactCapture.title: Ask guests for contact details
contactCapture.description: Never: guests are not asked. Before first: before the first message. On handoff: when the chat is handed to a person.

newGuestsPerNetwork.title: New guests per network (IP) per 15 minutes
newGuestsPerNetwork.description: A device that sends no guest key starts a new guest; more new guests than this from one network address in 15 minutes are refused for a while (too many requests). 0 = no limit (many shoppers can share one mobile network address).
